sources.title: Blockmedia — Binance names Momentum (MMT) 56th HODLer Airdrops project (published 2025-11-03 17:26 KST)
sources.excerpt: Relays Binance's 3 Nov 2025 announcement: spot listing 4 Nov 2025 12:00 UTC with Seed Tag, pairs USDT/USDC/BNB/TRY. Total supply 1,000,000,000 MMT; circulating at listing ~204,095,424 (20.41%); HODLer airdrop 7.5M (0.75%); a further 5M MMT for marketing after listing and 1.25M six months later. Inflation to start ~6 months after TGE with the ve(3,3) DEX. Sui contract 0x35169bc93e1fddfcf3a82a9eae726d349689ed59e4b065369af8789fe59f8608::mmt::MMT. No listing fee.

sources.title: NFT Plazas — Momentum (MMT) to Binance HODLer Airdrops (published 2025-11-04 03:48 UTC)
sources.excerpt: 56th HODLer Airdrops project, Seed Tag; 7.5M MMT airdrop; listing 4 Nov 2025 12:00 UTC. Total supply 1B; circulating at listing ~204,095,424 (20.41%), attributed to Binance. Locking MMT gives veMMT for gauge and treasury votes; LPs earn MMT emissions and veMMT holders are to receive 100% of trading fees and bribes.

sources.title: Coinone Research — MMT digital asset manual (exchange listing disclosure dated 2025-11-04)
sources.excerpt: Issuer RIZE Labs Inc (Panama, corporation); key person Wendy Fu (CEO). Total issuance cap and issued supply 1,000,000,000; circulating 204,095,424; locked tokens released on schedule through May 2031. Security incidents in past 3 years: none. Security audits: Asymptotic, MoveBit (no dates, scope or results given). Conflicts of interest: none disclosed. No foundation wallet addresses or holder distribution given.

sources.title: Coinone Research — MMT digital asset info (dated 2025-11-04)
sources.excerpt: 20.41% of supply unlocked at TGE, of which 11.41% public sale and community. Investors: 0% at TGE, 12-month cliff then 48-month gradual unlock. Team: fully locked 48 months after TGE. veMMT governance (proposals, parameters, emissions). Products: CLMM DEX (Uniswap v3 style), xSUI, MSafe, TGL launchpad, vaults, Momentum X.

sources.title: Momentum docs — Whitepaper (live page; metrics snapshot dated 25 Oct 2025)
sources.excerpt: As of 25 Oct 2025: 1.68M+ unique swap users, 1.42M+ LPs, TVL $600M+, cumulative volume $25B+. Total supply 1,000,000,000; TGE circulating 204,095,424. Ecosystem 13% (9% at TGE, 24-month vesting); community growth 42.72%; investors and early supporters 24.78% (0% at TGE, minimum 1-year cliff); public sale 1.5% (100% at TGE); team 18% (4-year cliff). Emissions start 3–6 months after TGE when the DEX moves to ve(3,3). Roadmap: perp DEX and TGL Q1 2026, Momentum X Q2 2026. Live page, may have been edited after the listing date.

sources.title: Decrypt / Chainwire (sponsored) — $MMT Community Offering goes live on Buidlpad (2025-10-10)

sources.excerpt: TVL reportedly fell from $700M to $327M after the Buidlpad HODL campaign ended (no source given). Team tokens locked 48 months; investors 12-month cliff then 48 months; 20.41% at TGE. $14.5M raised across seed, strategic and public rounds. Prime Sale 31 Oct 2025.

circulating_supply.note: circulating at listing per Binance announcement; same figure in MMT-02 and MMT-04

total_supply.note: genesis supply. Binance says supply is not capped and inflation starts ~6 months after TGE (MMT-03); Coinone's filing calls 1B the issuance cap (MMT-04)

fdv_to_mcap.note: price-independent: total supply / circulating at listing = 1,000,000,000 / 204,095,424. Supplied directly because no listing-time price is used (see manifest notes)

team_vesting_months.note: team fully locked 48 months after TGE; vesting length after the lock is not disclosed, so 48 is a floor

unlock_12m_pct_of_circ.note: ESTIMATE. Ecosystem: remaining 4% over 24 months = 20M in 12 months (MMT-13). Community growth: 42.72% - 9.91% at TGE = 328.1M, assumed linear to the May-2031 end of the release schedule (MMT-04), ~66 months = ~59.7M in 12 months. Investor cliff ends at month 12 and is excluded; team locked. (20M + 59.7M) / 204.1M = 39%. The community schedule is not published, so this is an assumption

unlock_90d_pct_of_circ.note: ESTIMATE on the same assumptions as the 12-month figure: ecosystem 5M + community ~14.9M = ~19.9M / 204.1M. Excludes 5M marketing tokens already counted in circulating
